auth.label: Authenticate with Spotify
auth.description: This button will redirect you to Spotify to authenticate.

auth_dev.label: Authenticate Developer Session
auth_dev.description: Authenticate with your custom Client ID.

clear_auth_dev.label: Clear Developer Authentication
clear_auth_dev.description: Clear the developer session authentication and client ID.

sync_podcast_progress.label: Sync Podcast Progress from Spotify
sync_podcast_progress.description: Automatically sync episode played status from Spotify to Music Assistant. Episodes marked as played in Spotify will be marked as played in MA. Only enable this if you use both the Spotify app and Music Assistant for podcast playback.

sync_audiobook_progress.label: Sync Audiobook Progress from Spotify
sync_audiobook_progress.description: Automatically sync audiobook progress from Spotify to Music Assistant. Progress from Spotify app will sync to MA when audiobooks are accessed. Only enable this if you use both the Spotify app and Music Assistant for audiobook playback.

authenticate.title: Connect your Spotify account
authenticate.description: A browser window will open so you can sign in to Spotify and authorize Music Assistant. Come back here once you're done.

developer.title: Use your own Spotify developer key (optional)
developer.description:
You're connected using Music Assistant's shared Spotify developer key — that's all most people need, so you can just press Finish.

If you'd rather use your own Spotify developer key, enter the Client ID below. This avoids shared rate limits, although recommendations and similar tracks will continue to use Music Assistant's shared key due to Spotify API restrictions.

Register {0} as a redirect URI in the Spotify Developer Dashboard. Leave the Client ID empty to continue using the shared key.

authenticate_dev.title: Authorize your Spotify app
authenticate_dev.description: A browser window will open to authorize Music Assistant against your own Spotify app.

playback_auth.title: Allow Music Assistant to play Spotify audio
playback_auth.description:
Playing audio needs a separate one-time approval from Spotify, on top of the sign-in you just completed.

**Recommended: use the Spotify app.** Pick this if you have Spotify installed on a phone, tablet or computer on the same network as Music Assistant. It's a few taps and nothing to copy or paste.

**Use a web browser instead.** Pick this if Music Assistant won't show up in your Spotify app — for example when it runs on a different network or VLAN, or in a container without access to your home network. It takes a couple of extra steps.

playback_pairing.title: Connect to Music Assistant in your Spotify app
playback_pairing.description:
Follow these steps in the Spotify app — this page continues on its own when you're done.

1. Open the Spotify app on your phone, tablet or computer.
2. Start playing any song, so the player bar appears.
3. Tap the **speaker icon** (Connect to a device) in the player bar.
4. Choose **{0}** from the list of devices.

Audio won't actually play on it — selecting it is only used to grant permission, and you can switch back to your usual speaker straight after.

Not showing up? Make sure the device running Spotify is on the same network as Music Assistant, then wait for this step to time out and choose the web browser option instead.

playback_browser.title: Approve playback in your browser
playback_browser.description:
Follow these steps in order:

1. Open this link in a new tab: {0}
2. Sign in to Spotify if asked, then press **Agree**.
3. Your browser will end up on an error page that won't load — something like “This site can't be reached” for an address starting with 127.0.0.1. **That is expected and means it worked.**
4. Copy the full web address of that error page from your browser's address bar.
5. Paste it into the box below and press Submit.

The address is long and contains a one-time code, so paste the whole thing without editing it.

errors.refresh_token_invalid: Your Spotify session has expired or been revoked. Please re-authenticate to continue using Spotify.
errors.pairing_not_completed: Music Assistant wasn't selected in the Spotify app in time. Try again, or use the web browser option if Music Assistant doesn't appear in your Spotify app.
errors.playback_code_invalid: That address could not be used. Make sure you copied the complete address of the error page, and note that each attempt can only be used once — start over to get a new link.
errors.playback_auth_required: Spotify needs you to approve audio playback again. Open the Spotify provider settings and run through the setup once more to restore playback.
